evidence.title: editorcn - Beautiful rich text editors, made simple

name: editorcn
summary: Rich text editor components for React, built on Tiptap and distributed through the shadcn registry or npm.
description: A monorepo of rich text editor components for the shadcn/ui ecosystem: a toolbar-style RichTextEditor with sticky toolbar, 20+ built-in controls, bubble menu and link extension, a Notion-style BlockEditor with slash commands, drag handles, image and table blocks, an extensions package and a static renderer for saved content. Installs through the shadcn registry or npm; templates cover a Comment Box and a Simple Document Editor. The site now serves at www.rtecn.space.
contains: two editor packages: @editorcn/editor (toolbar editor) and @editorcn/block-editor (Notion-style blocks)
20+ built-in toolbar controls (Bold, H1, Link, Undo); sticky toolbar with control groups
BlockEditor: slash command menu, bubble menu, drag handles, block actions, image and table blocks
templates: Comment Box and Simple Document Editor, installed as shadcn blocks
5 shadcn registry items, 7 docs pages; install via the shadcn registry or npm
built on Tiptap with full TypeScript support and shadcn/ui design tokens
every component is free; sponsorship never paywalls features
